definition: The topographic position index (TPI) of Guisan et al. (1999): the difference between the elevation of each cell and the mean elevation of its neighbourhood.

hasAction.description: The object identifier of this item moves from https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/activity-type/topographic-position-index to https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/activity-type/topographic-position-index, which resolves through w3id.org (decision of 2026-11-17); the register actions of the item move with it, under https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/activity-type/topographic-position-index/actions/. The old IRI is kept as owl:sameAs. The content of the item is unchanged. Classified clarifying: the item is the same, only its identifier changes.

The parent class (rdfs:subClassOf) changes from https://w3id.org/ogc/rim/geoprocessing/GeoprocessingActivityType to the family https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/activity-type/terrain-derivative, itself a sub-class of it (decision of 2026-11-19: activity types grouped by meaning). The definition and the entity types are unchanged. Classified substantive, a change of parent class.

source.title: Guisan, A., Weiss, S.B., Weiss, A.D. (1999): GLM versus CCA spatial modeling of plant species distribution. Plant Ecology 143: 107-122
